description.value: West Coast Smokery is a South Vancouver neighbourhood deli and specialty food shop located in Champlain Square, operating for over seven years and recently under new ownership since 2024. The shop specialises in organic, non-medicated smoked meats — grass-fed beef, artisan sausages, and halal/kosher selections — alongside hard-to-find Mexican and European imports such as dried chiles and artisan cheeses. A touring cyclist passing through South Vancouver can stock up on high-quality protein and specialty provisions not found in chain stores.
